text_block_list.text: …It's not enough.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh, no, the racewear itself is wonderful. I can tell the person who made it really poured their heart into making it the way I wanted.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: But… it's still not enough. My signature racewear needs an extra oomph of cuteness.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Now the rest is up to me… and you, of course! We've got work to do!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: That fabric is made from pearls. I heard there's a type of pearl in a certain ocean that can be used to create fabric that shines beautifully if crushed and mixed.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: That said, it's not a very noticeable shine. It's more of a "if you know, you know" type of thing.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: But just imagine it. A mystical light emitting from me while I run… Think of the impression that'd leave!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It's perfect, just what I need! Come look for it with me! Pleeeaaase!

text_block_list.text: I want the color of my signature racewear to be perfect. Not just any old dye will do.

text_block_list.text: They say that if you use it to dye fabric, it'll turn into a color that captivates anyone who lays eyes on it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: But apparently, you have to go past a bunch of booby traps to get to it…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It could be a dangerous trip. But… I need that flower no matter what! Will you come with me? Pleeease!
